dataset: SAFE-Loop Deserialization and file handling set (hard) v0.1
test_layout: 12 tests per task; tests 1-6 = visible pool, tests 7-12 = fixed hidden set; every test is labelled hard; visible tests are not shown when runner uses k=0.
notes: Pure-Python deterministic deserialization / file-format tasks. Every test is labelled hard by design. For every task the expected values come from a from-scratch reference implementation that was cross-checked on all 12 tests against an independent authority (Python standard-library parsers such as zipfile, tarfile, pickletools, tomllib, plistlib, zlib, sqlite3, or the git command-line tool) or a second independent implementation; a deliberately naive variant fails at least one test of every task. The tasks have NOT been run against target LLMs: the intended <50% first-attempt task pass rate is an empirical target, not a verified result. 'forbid' lists standard-library modules the candidate may not import, so the format has to be implemented rather than delegated. No reference_solution field is included.

tasks.title: ZIP central-directory reader
tasks.prompt: Implement ZIP central-directory reading as described by PKWARE APPNOTE 6.3.x, ZIP64 included. Return one [name, compression_method, compressed_size, uncompressed_size, crc32_hex] entry per central-directory record, in directory order. Raise ValueError for a malformed archive.

tasks.title: TAR member reader (ustar, pax, GNU long names)
tasks.prompt: Read the members of a tar archive as defined by POSIX.1-2001 (ustar and pax) together with the GNU long-name extensions. Return [name, size, typeflag, linkname] for each member in archive order. Raise ValueError for a malformed archive.

tasks.title: Pickle opcode lister
tasks.prompt: List the opcode names of a Python pickle stream in order, up to and including STOP, for protocols 0 through 5, without executing anything. Raise ValueError if the stream is truncated, exhausted before STOP, or contains an unknown opcode.

tasks.title: TOML 1.0 parser
tasks.prompt: Implement a TOML v1.0.0 parser. Return the document as nested JSON-compatible values. Represent date-times as [kind, iso_text] where kind is datetime (with offset, written +HH:MM, never Z), local-datetime, date or time, and fractional seconds are six digits when non-zero and omitted otherwise. Represent nan and infinities as {"float": "nan" | "inf" | "-inf"}. Raise ValueError for any document the specification rejects.

tasks.title: Apple binary property list parser
tasks.prompt: Parse an Apple binary property list (bplist00) without executing anything. Return strings, numbers, booleans, null and arrays as JSON values, dictionaries as objects, data as ["data", hex], dates as ["date", seconds_since_2001_01_01 as a float] and UIDs as ["uid", n]. Raise ValueError for a malformed or self-referential file.

tasks.title: DEFLATE decompressor with an output limit
tasks.signature: def inflate(data_hex: str, max_output: int) -> str
tasks.prompt: Implement a raw DEFLATE (RFC 1951) decompressor that never produces more than max_output bytes. Return the decompressed bytes as lowercase hex. Raise ValueError for an invalid or truncated stream or when the output would exceed max_output.

tasks.title: CBOR deterministic decoder (RFC 8949)
tasks.prompt: Decode one CBOR data item (RFC 8949) that must follow the deterministic encoding rules of section 4.2: preferred serialization, no indefinite lengths, map keys in bytewise order of their encodings, no duplicate keys. Return integers, floats, text, booleans, null and arrays as JSON values, byte strings as {"bytes": hex}, maps as a list of [key, value] pairs in encoded order, undefined as {"undefined": true}, other simple values as {"simple": n}, tags as {"tag": n, "value": item}, and nan or infinities as {"float": "nan" | "inf" | "-inf"}. Raise ValueError for malformed or non-deterministic input, or trailing bytes.

tasks.title: SQLite schema table reader
tasks.prompt: Read the schema table (sqlite_schema, the table b-tree rooted at page 1) of a SQLite 3 database file as described in the SQLite file-format documentation, without using a SQLite library. Return [type, name, tbl_name, rootpage, sql] for every row in rowid order, with sql null when absent. Raise ValueError for a file that is not a valid database or is truncated.

tasks.title: gitignore matcher
tasks.signature: def gitignore_ignored(rules: list, path: str, is_dir: bool) -> bool
tasks.prompt: Implement the matching rules of gitignore(5) for a single .gitignore file at the repository root. rules is the list of lines of that file, path is a slash-separated path relative to the repository root, and is_dir says whether the final component is a directory. Return True if git would ignore the path.

tasks.title: multipart/form-data parser
tasks.signature: def multipart_parse(content_type: str, body_hex: str) -> list
tasks.prompt: Parse a multipart/form-data request body according to RFC 7578 together with the boundary rules of RFC 2046 and the filename* syntax of RFC 8187. Return [name, filename, part_content_type, data_hex] for every part in order, using null for a missing filename or part Content-Type. Raise ValueError for a malformed message.

tasks.title: PNG chunk validator
tasks.prompt: Validate a PNG file against ISO/IEC 15948 (PNG 1.2/RFC 2083 rules) and summarise it. Return {"width", "height", "bit_depth", "color_type", "interlace", "idat_chunks", "text"} where text is the list of [keyword, text] pairs of the tEXt chunks in order. Raise ValueError for any file that violates the format.

tasks.title: ISO base media (MP4) box tree parser
tasks.prompt: Parse the box structure of an ISO base media file (ISO/IEC 14496-12). Return [type, size, children] for every box, where children is a list for the container boxes moov, trak, mdia, minf, stbl, dinf, edts, udta, mvex, moof, traf and meta (a FullBox whose 4 version/flag bytes precede its children) and null otherwise; type is the four-character code, or "uuid:" plus 32 hex digits for extended types. Nesting deeper than 16 levels is malformed. Raise ValueError for malformed input.

tasks.title: ZIP overlapping-entry (bomb) detector
tasks.prompt: Detect overlapping-entry ZIP bombs. Return True if the byte ranges occupied by any two entries (local header, name, extra field and compressed data) overlap each other or run into the central directory, otherwise False. Take offsets and compressed sizes from the central directory (ZIP64 included) and the name and extra-field lengths from each local header. Raise ValueError for a malformed archive.

tasks.title: Tar extraction safety planner
tasks.prompt: Decide whether extracting a tar archive into a destination directory is safe, following the rules of Python's data extraction filter (PEP 706). entries is a list of [name, type, linkname] with type file, dir, symlink or hardlink, processed in order, so links created earlier affect later members. Return the member names with leading slashes removed, or raise ValueError if any member would be written or linked outside the destination.

tasks.title: gzip multi-member parser and verifier
tasks.prompt: Parse a gzip file (RFC 1952), possibly several concatenated members, and verify it. Return [name, comment, mtime, os, isize] for each member, with name and comment null when absent. Raise ValueError for a malformed or corrupt file.

tasks.title: XML encoding detection
tasks.prompt: Determine the character encoding of an XML document from its first bytes as described in XML 1.0 Appendix F and from its XML declaration. Return the encoding name in upper case (UTF-8, UTF-16BE, UTF-16LE, UTF-32BE, UTF-32LE, or the declared name). Raise ValueError for empty input or a malformed XML declaration.

tasks.title: PHP unserialize (data only)
tasks.prompt: Decode PHP serialize() output that contains only data. Return null, booleans, integers and strings as JSON values, floats as numbers ({"float": "nan" | "inf" | "-inf"} for NAN and infinities), and arrays as a list of [key, value] pairs in order. Raise ValueError for malformed input, trailing data, or any object or reference type.

tasks.title: ZipCrypto (PKWARE traditional encryption) decryptor
tasks.signature: def zipcrypto_decrypt(password: str, data_hex: str, check_byte: int) -> str
tasks.prompt: Decrypt the data of a traditionally encrypted ZIP entry (PKWARE APPNOTE section 6.1). data_hex is the 12-byte encryption header followed by the encrypted data, and the last decrypted header byte must equal check_byte. Return the decrypted data as lowercase hex. Raise ValueError for a non-ASCII password, a wrong check byte, or less than 12 bytes of data.

tasks.title: WebAssembly module section lister
tasks.prompt: List the sections of a WebAssembly binary module as defined by the WebAssembly core specification (binary format). Return [section_id, custom_name, size] for every section in order, with custom_name null for non-custom sections. Raise ValueError for a malformed module, including sections out of the required order.

tasks.title: Unix ar archive member lister
tasks.prompt: List the members of a Unix ar archive (System V/GNU format with the // long-name table). Return [name, size] for every regular member in order, excluding the symbol table and the name table. Raise ValueError for a malformed archive.
